title: rubus corchorifolius var. coptophyllus
intro: Rubus corchorifolius var. coptophyllus, commonly known as the Indian Raspberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rubus corchorifolius var. coptophyllus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
